data.description:
## 1. Technical Environment
* **DSO version:** 1.16.11
* **Context:** CLAUDE.md references /dso:review and /dso:commit skills. When an agent tries to invoke /dso:review, the skill is not found.

## 2. Incident Overview
* **Scenario Type:** User-Flagged Behavior

#### Expected Behavior
Documentation and CLAUDE.md that reference /dso:review should either:
(a) point to the actual review workflow markdown file (REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md), or
(b) have a shallow skill stub that reads the workflow doc and delegates to it.
Agents that need to run a code review should be able to invoke /dso:review and have it work.

#### Actual Behavior
Documentation and CLAUDE.md reference /dso:review as a skill to invoke, but the skill does not exist in the project. The review workflow is a markdown file at plugins/dso/docs/workflows/REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md that must be executed inline. Agents that invoke /dso:review via the Skill tool get 'skill not found'.

## 3. Root Cause Hypothesis
Missing: a shallow review skill file (plugins/dso/skills/review/SKILL.md or similar) that loads REVIEW-WORKFLOW.md and executes it, or documentation corrections to point to the markdown workflow file directly.
data.title: [review-skill]: documentation refers to /dso:review skill -> skill not found; review workflow is a markdown file that needs a shallow skill entry point
